title: Simon NDE 7243
content: I don't actually remember a large portion of the day prior to the event, and I still can't. I was working on deck on a private yacht, in a private marina. I vaguely remember arriving in the morning and eating lunch in the afternoon, and bits and pieces in between. At some point, I must have fallen overboard. My first memory was my fiancΘe coming to me. She was standing over me saying, 'Wake up Simon, you have to wake up'. I could see her face, calm but insistent. It was almost like I was late for work. The next thing I remember, I am awake, face down in the lake with a mouth full of water. I cleared my lungs as I tried to swim toward the back of the boat. I got up on the back of the boat, climbed into the aft cockpit, and climbed onto the main deck. I was expecting to see my fiancΘe standing there. She was not. Obviously, I had sustained a moderate concussion. I also have a bruised hip, elbow and a baseball sized knot on the back of my head. I could not remember where I was, who I was or the events leading up to the event. I have had concussions in the past and knew the symptoms. The only thing I could remember was Kristi. I sat down, grabbed my phone, called her, and told her I needed help. Oddly enough, she had left work early and was only about 15 minutes away from the marina. When she got there, she said I was very lucky I called when I did. She was just about home, was going to shut her phone off, and take a nap. I told her the story. She had told me she had a feeling she needed to leave work early and did. I have been close to death a couple times before and had actually drowned as a small child. In all of those times, I have never experienced a vision, flying saucers, lights or tunnels, a deity or anyone coming to me. The only reason I am able to write this today is because of very special woman and my relationship with her. It is, and has been a firm belief of mine that we, as humans, possess a certain amount of telepathy (for lack of a better word). When we are close with loved ones or friends, we have a certain amount of 'connection'. If it is allowed to develop, the possibilities are endless in what we are capable of. I am LIVING proof.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Fell overboard from a private yacht and was found face down in a lake with water in lungs (near-drowning) and concussion.

person_demographics.occupation: Working on deck on a private yacht

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: He reports no lights, tunnels, deities, or beings; primary anomalous element is his fiancée appearing/communicating: 'Wake up Simon, you have to wake up,' and her reporting a feeling to leave work early.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Apparent telepathic/connection experience with fiancée: he 'first memory' is her standing over him urging him to wake; she later reports feeling she needed to leave work early and did, enabling timely assistance.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “Wake up Simon, you have to wake up”
